scope: Current Jellyfin service read completion ownership after a committed account/library change or sign-out. Actual service/ownedHTTP evidence;no native or live-server wrong-data presentation is claimed.
problem: Single-root catalog,libraries,filters and direct song/album reads could return delayed old data. Other composite methods rejected stale successful pages but could propagate delayed old401/server errors. JSON-only checks leave a queued continuation gap before public mapping completes.
change: readCurrentSession captures the committed immutable Session object and checks after success or failure. Wrap all10 public async data reads plus private entries used by playlist preflights. Keep request/json/authentication/publication/mutation bodies unchanged.

decision.mode: Team-work bounded read-only Boris/Nadia proposals,one exchanged challenge,root implementation and both actual-diff reviews.
decision.Boris: Initially proposed JSON GET boundary;after challenge supported public/composite boundary because queued commits can precede public continuation. Final support,no blocker.
decision.Nadia: Initially proposed public/composite helper;challenge supported narrower JSON boundary with future-composite reservation. Root chose public boundary after queued-microtask evidence. Review identified private entries preflight failure scope;wrapped and18 cases added. Reservation resolved,no blocker.
decision.Morgan: Choose public read completion boundary using actual Session object identity. Do not invalidate for unchanged parallel reads or pending connection intent;do not guard mutation confirmation as a read.

method.service: Bundle actual current/baseline JellyfinService and shared helpers. Real owned localhost HTTP server and response bodies,not mocked fetch. Every baseline and final case uses a fresh service with dummy credentials.
method.connectionPersistence: Fixture adapter commits synchronously in memory. Changes invoke actual selectLibraries,connect or disconnect. No OS credential/publication persistence fault is exercised.
method.delays: Hold exactly the first target HTTP response,commit the change,then release status200 or401. No timer/deadline rewrite.
method.queuedProbe: Instrument the service nested json return to queue restore of another committed snapshot before the public continuation. This is an explicit scheduler probe,not a naturally reproduced native race.
method.mutationRegression: Real local create/status-only requests;confirmed/malformed/missing JSON and status200 with an unused stalled body. Create confirmation also tested after an account change.
method.cleanup: Each owned server closes all connections and terminates in its script finally;both matrix processes exit0.

results.unchangedConcurrentReads: Four simultaneous reads succeed with the same committed session in both phases.

groups.actor: Listener changing account or accessible libraries
groups.trigger: A pending Jellyfin data/preflight read settles after the committed session changes
groups.outcome: Reject the obsolete read rather than returning old data or an obsolete authentication failure.
remaining: Controlled actual-service boundary proof is not native UI account/selection handoff or a complete live server/version matrix.
Full connection publication,physical storage,auth screen lifetime and listener/platform requirements retain their separate evidence.

validation.integration: Both baseline/final expanded matrices exit0. Final60 public stale cases,5 queued probes,18 stale preflights,4 optional outcomes,10 mutation cases and concurrent read group pass.
validation.buildTypecheck: Final npm run build exit0,including TypeScript and voice-resource check.
validation.unitTests: No unit tests/framework added or run.
validation.reviews: Boris and Nadia independently reviewed final source and supplied scoped evidence;no additional tests from reviewers.

limits: No new native UI/live Jellyfin/provider,audible,VoiceOver,OS or listener result. Renderer is unchanged.
HTTP success/401 and queued commit probes do not represent every transport,body shape or scheduling order. Existing20-second deadline remains unchanged.
No smaller viewport,200% zoom,packaging or release check.
